name: obsidian-latest-arrivals
description: 「最新入库」— 找出通过 Syncthing 等第三方同步工具最新到达本机的 Obsidian 笔记。

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.release: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-version.mjs && git add -A && git commit -m "release: v$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version")" && node scripts/publish.mjs
